about: A labelled passage from the reference world. In the text, {{key:kind|words}} marks a place where an entry is meant; everything else is plain prose. Kinds: name (the entry's name as written in the story bible), alias (one of its other names), mark (the author marked it), answered (a phrase the author has answered a question about), partial (part of a name, such as a first name alone), epithet (a description nobody has answered yet), pronoun.
text: {{mara:name|Mara Voss}} climbed {{tower:name|Glasslight Tower}} before the tide turned.
{{mara:pronoun|She}} had kept the light for thirty years, and {{harbor:alias|the harbor}} had stopped thanking {{mara:pronoun|her}} for it.
Below, {{kindlers:name|the Kindlers}} were stacking {{salt:name|Ember Salt}} on the quay, and an ember from their brazier drifted up past the gallery.
The {{lens:name|Tideglass Lens}} had come back from the mainland a month ago, and {{ivo:mark|@Ivo}} had sworn it was untouched.
Hope was all {{mara:pronoun|she}} had left to go on.
"You should not be up there alone," {{ivo:name|Ivo Renn}} called.
{{ivo:answered|The forger}} had a way of sounding kind.
{{hope:name|Hope}} stood beside {{ivo:pronoun|him}}, holding a lantern, and said nothing.
"{{mara:alias|The lightkeeper}} goes where the light is," {{mara:partial|Mara}} said.
{{mara:epithet|The old keeper}} did not look down.
Somewhere in {{harbor:name|Lantern Harbor}} a bell began to ring, and {{kindlers:alias|Kindlers}} ran for the boats.
The old woman at the chandlery, who was nobody's keeper, shut her door.
{{mara:mark|[[the lightkeeper]]}} had no hope of sleep now.
